Resolves #21990

The sortable dashboard's windows now open on their own `?theme=`. Before this, every later window took the first window's theme:
- A tile dragged out of a dashboard that the visitor had switched to Neo Dark opened a light window, because its `?theme=` was ignored.
- A second dashboard tab opened on the first tab's theme.

Both entry points now resolve from the booting window's configuration, `Neo.windowConfigs?.[Neo.bootingWindowId] || Neo.config`. That is the lookup Dock Choreography got in #21979.

Evidence: L3 (a browser spec of window pairs in one context, red on `dev`'s entry points, plus frames) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4).

CI jobs: +0. The renamed spec runs in the existing e2e-engine matrix.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI e2e: `dashboard/SharedWorkerStartTheme.spec.mjs`. "A tile opened in its own window follows its dashboard switched to Neo Dark" takes the visitor's path: switch the dashboard, then the tile's window button. "A detached sortable tile" boots the window directly, in both directions. |
| AC-2 | CI e2e: the same spec, "the sortable dashboard", in both orders. |
| AC-3 | CI e2e: in every pair, the spec's first window opens on its own request. `dashboard/SortableDashboard.spec.mjs` passes 3/3 locally at the head, and CI's e2e-engine runs it. |
| AC-4 | With `dev`'s two `app.mjs` files, the window-button case fails at "the tile's window: body", and the four sortable pair cases fail too. At the head, 7 of 7 pass. |

## Deltas from ticket
- `ChoreographyStartTheme.spec.mjs` (#21979) became `SharedWorkerStartTheme.spec.mjs`: one spec for the class, with its two Choreography cases unchanged.
- A seventh case drives the real detach through a tile's window button, so the spec also covers the dashboard passing the tile's theme along. The first frames, a widget window opened by URL, were empty and showed none of that.

## Test Evidence
Window pairs in one browser context, measured on `dev` at `72f7796f70` and at `c98869c20d`:

| First window | Second window requests | `dev` | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| dashboard, no request → Neo Light | widget, Neo Dark | `neo-theme-neo-light` | `neo-theme-neo-dark` |
| dashboard, Neo Dark | widget, Neo Light | `neo-theme-neo-dark` | `neo-theme-neo-light` |

`SharedWorkerStartTheme.spec.mjs` with `dev`'s two `app.mjs` files: the four sortable pair cases fail at `c98869c20d`, the window-button case fails at `f04052e27f`, and the two Choreography cases pass (Choreography was fixed on `dev` already). At `f04052e27f`: 7 passed.

The real detach: the dashboard opens on Neo Light, the visitor switches it to Neo Dark, then opens Orders in its own window with the tile's window button. The window requests `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark`. Its body is `neo-theme-neo-light` on `dev`'s entry points and `neo-theme-neo-dark` here.

The dashboard after the switch, Orders gone to its own window (1280 × 800, the same on both):

![dashboard](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/fd9010496d01b279ae304ca114c7d41a07bfb3a6/review-evidence/21990/head-sortable-dashboard-switched-dark-1280x800.png?raw=true)

The Orders window, whole, at the size the dashboard opens it (1240 × 112):

| `dev` | This PR |
|---|---|
| ![dev](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/fd9010496d01b279ae304ca114c7d41a07bfb3a6/review-evidence/21990/base-sortable-orders-window.png?raw=true) | ![head](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/fd9010496d01b279ae304ca114c7d41a07bfb3a6/review-evidence/21990/head-sortable-orders-window.png?raw=true) |

Frame critique: on `dev`, the tile's window is the light card beside the dark dashboard, and that is the defect. Here it matches. Nothing else in the frames changes.
